sloka: एवम् कथयमानः स ददर्श आश्रम मण्डलम् ।कुश चीर परिक्षिप्तम् ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समावृतम् ॥३-११-२१॥
transliteration: evam kathayamānaḥ sa dadarśa āśrama maṇḍalam ।kuśa cīra parikṣiptam brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam ॥3-11-21॥

translations.english: When the sage Dharmabrata was telling the story, Rama saw a hermitage strewn all over with kusa grass and bark garments, and endowed with pure brahminic grace.
